dataset.name: Kriko Product Research Benchmark
dataset.design: Thirty newly written, source-backed product research questions: five product categories, two questions per category and job type, and two repetitions per profile. The earlier nine-question corpus remains a development/history block and is not pooled into this holdout.
dataset.ground_truth_policy: Each case has an answer key, criterion-to-source map, and direct primary-source ledger. Candidates receive only the question. Two blinded model judges receive the rubric and only evidence actually supplied to the candidate.
dataset.originality: Question wording and answer keys were written for this benchmark. Public benchmark papers informed the separation of simple fact lookup, multi-source reasoning, ambiguity handling, and independently checkable answers; their question sets were not copied.

cases.question: For the men's Merrell Moab 3 Mid Waterproof, verify the waterproof construction and the upper materials from Merrell's own specification.

criteria.fact: Merrell specifies a waterproof membrane that seals out water while allowing moisture to escape.
The upper is pig suede leather and breathable mesh.

ground_truth.expected_answer: The men's Moab 3 Mid Waterproof uses a waterproof, breathable membrane and a pig-suede-leather/breathable-mesh upper.

cases.question: For Salomon SPEEDCROSS 6 GORE-TEX, verify the membrane claim, drop and lug depth from the exact product page.

criteria.fact: This GORE-TEX variant has a waterproof, breathable GORE-TEX membrane.
The listed drop is 10 mm.
The listed lug depth is 5 mm.

ground_truth.expected_answer: The exact SPEEDCROSS 6 GORE-TEX page lists a waterproof/breathable GORE-TEX membrane, 10 mm drop and 5 mm lugs.

cases.question: A listing says only Moab 3 Mid. Compare Merrell's non-waterproof and Waterproof versions and tell me whether the family name alone proves this pair will keep water out.

criteria.fact: Merrell lists Moab 3 Mid and Moab 3 Mid Waterproof as distinct variants; the unqualified family name does not establish waterproof construction.
The Waterproof product has a waterproof membrane.
Ask for the complete style name, SKU or product label before making a definite claim about the listed pair.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Merrell lists a Moab 3 Mid as non-waterproof and a separate Moab 3 Mid Waterproof. The seller's abbreviated name is insufficient; ask for the full style/SKU or label.

cases.question: My SPEEDCROSS 6 GORE-TEX got muddy and now lets water in. Give Salomon's cleaning and drying instructions, and say what this observation does and does not prove about a defect.

criteria.fact: The named GORE-TEX variant is specified as waterproof and breathable; this does not diagnose this particular pair.
Salomon advises removing dirt/mud with water and a soft wet brush.
Salomon says not to machine-wash the shoes.
Dry at room temperature away from direct sun and external heat.
One wet-use report cannot establish the cause or a model-wide defect rate; the individual pair needs inspection/appropriate support.

ground_truth.expected_answer: The GTX page specifies a waterproof/breathable membrane. Clean with water and a soft wet brush, do not machine-wash, and dry at room temperature away from sun and heat. A single report cannot identify the leak path or establish prevalence; contact Salomon for the individual pair.

cases.question: A used listing says only Merrell Moab 3 Mid. Can I count on it for wet hikes? Ask for the missing identifying detail before deciding.

criteria.fact: Ask for the full product name/SKU or a clear photo of the tongue/box label to distinguish the waterproof version.
Do not infer waterproofness from the Moab 3 family name alone.
Conditional advice is acceptable, but a definite answer waits for identification.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Ask for the complete model/SKU or label photo; Merrell sells both non-waterproof and waterproof Moab 3 Mid variants, so the family name alone is insufficient.

cases.question: Someone gave me Salomon Speedcross 6 shoes with no box. Are they waterproof, and can I machine-wash them? Ask what you need before giving a definite instruction.

criteria.fact: Ask whether the shoe is the GORE-TEX version or request the article/SKU/label photo.
Do not transfer the GTX waterproof claim to every Speedcross 6 variant.
Do not give a definite care instruction until the shoe is identified; Salomon's guidance says not to machine-wash.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Ask for the full article number/label and whether the pair is the GORE-TEX variant. The GTX waterproof claim is variant-specific; Salomon's shoe-care page advises against machine washing.

cases.question: For the MacBook Air (M1, 2020), verify how many external displays it natively supports and the maximum listed resolution/refresh rate.

criteria.fact: The MacBook Air (M1, 2020) supports one external display.
The listed maximum is up to 6K resolution at 60 Hz.

ground_truth.expected_answer: The 2020 M1 MacBook Air supports one external display up to 6K at 60 Hz.

cases.question: For the 14-inch MacBook Pro with base M3 (November 2023), what is the supported external-display count with the lid open, and what one-display resolutions are listed for Thunderbolt and HDMI?

criteria.fact: With the built-in display in use, base M3 supports one external display up to 6K at 60 Hz over Thunderbolt.
The HDMI port supports one display up to 4K at 120 Hz on the base M3 model.

ground_truth.expected_answer: With the lid open, the November 2023 14-inch base-M3 model supports one external display up to 6K/60 Hz over Thunderbolt; HDMI supports one display up to 4K/120 Hz.

cases.question: A 14-inch MacBook Pro has the base M3 chip. Can I run two external monitors? Explain the lid-open versus lid-closed configurations, required macOS versions, and why the M3 Pro spec should not be substituted.

criteria.fact: With the built-in screen active, base M3 supports one external display.
Base M3 can support two external displays with the laptop lid closed, in the supported configurations described by Apple.
Apple lists macOS Sonoma 14.6 or later for the MacBook Pro M3 closed-lid dual-display feature, plus power and an external keyboard/mouse or trackpad.
M3 Pro has a different two-display support envelope and must not be used as the base-M3 specification.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Open lid: one external display. Closed lid: two in Apple's supported pairings (up to 6K/60 Thunderbolt plus 5K/60 Thunderbolt, or 6K/60 Thunderbolt plus 4K/100 HDMI). MacBook Pro M3 requires macOS Sonoma 14.6+, external power, and an external keyboard/mouse or trackpad. M3 Pro is a different configuration and is not the answer for base M3.

cases.question: A Dell XPS 13 9310 clamshell has 16 GB RAM and a swollen battery. Verify whether RAM and SSD are replaceable, which SSD sizes Dell documents, and the safe immediate battery action. Do not use 2-in-1 instructions.

criteria.fact: RAM is integrated on the system board; it is not a user-replaceable memory module.
The clamshell's M.2 SSD is serviceable/removable; the 9310 2-in-1 must not be conflated with it.
Dell documents M.2 2230 and M.2 2280 SSD configurations; check the installed configuration before buying.
For a swollen battery, stop using the computer, power it off and disconnect AC; do not keep operating or charging it.

ground_truth.expected_answer: The 16 GB RAM is integrated and cannot be upgraded. The clamshell SSD is serviceable; Dell documents 2230 or 2280 configurations, so inspect the installed drive. For the swollen battery, stop use, power off and disconnect AC; arrange qualified service and do not keep using or charging it.

cases.question: A used 14-inch MacBook Pro listing says M3 and promises two monitors. Before saying yes or no, ask for the information that changes the answer.

criteria.fact: Confirm exact chip (base M3 versus M3 Pro) and MacBook Pro model/year.
Ask whether the user will close the lid and which macOS version is installed; base M3 dual-display support depends on setup and OS.
Do not make a definite two-display promise from the family name alone.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Ask the exact chip/model and macOS version, and whether the user will use the laptop with its lid closed. Do not infer support from 'MacBook Pro' alone.

cases.question: A listing says Dell XPS 13, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD. Can I upgrade the memory and drive? Ask what is needed to avoid mixing generations or the 2-in-1.

criteria.fact: Ask for exact XPS model/generation or service tag, and whether it is a clamshell or 2-in-1.
Do not infer RAM or SSD upgradeability from the XPS 13 family name and capacity alone.
Conditional explanation is allowed, but a definite upgrade claim must wait for identification.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Ask for the exact model/generation or service tag and confirm clamshell versus 2-in-1. The XPS 13 name and installed capacity do not settle RAM/SSD replaceability.

cases.question: For Toyota recall 20V-369 / 20TA10, identify the affected Prius model years and the hybrid-system defect/remedy from Toyota's NHTSA filing.

criteria.fact: The recall covers certain 2013–2015 Prius and 2014–2017 Prius V vehicles.
In rare circumstances the hybrid system may not enter failsafe mode as intended, potentially causing loss of power/stall.
The remedy is a hybrid-system software update; vehicles with specified inverter failures may need inverter repair/replacement.

ground_truth.expected_answer: 20V-369 applies to certain 2013–2015 Prius and 2014–2017 Prius V. A rare hybrid-system fault can prevent failsafe mode, causing loss of power/stall. Toyota's remedy is a software update; specified related inverter failures may require repair/replacement.

cases.question: For Toyota recall 20V-286, verify the affected RAV4 model years, the defect and the stated remedy.

criteria.fact: The notice concerns certain 2019–2020 RAV4 and RAV4 Hybrid vehicles; not every vehicle in those years is necessarily included.
Front lower suspension arms may separate from the front wheel assembly under certain conditions, risking loss of control.
Toyota instructs owners of affected vehicles to contact a dealer for parts replacement, free of charge.

ground_truth.expected_answer: 20V-286 covers certain 2019–2020 RAV4 and RAV4 Hybrid units. The front lower suspension arm may separate and cause loss of control; affected owners should arrange the free parts replacement through Toyota.

cases.question: A 2020 RAV4 Hybrid owner found Toyota notices 20V-012 and 20V-286. Are these the same defect? Compare scope, failure mode, and what the owner should do for this specific VIN.

criteria.fact: The campaigns are distinct: 20V-012 concerns a low-pressure fuel pump that may stop operating; 20V-286 concerns front lower suspension arms that may separate.
The filings list certain 2019–2020 RAV4-family vehicles in both campaign populations; model/year alone does not prove this VIN is included or unrepaired.
The 20V-012 remedy is replacement of the low-pressure fuel pump; 20V-286 requires dealer parts replacement for affected vehicles.
Use the 17-character VIN in NHTSA/Toyota's lookup to determine open recall status for this vehicle.

ground_truth.expected_answer: They are separate campaigns: 20V-012 is the low-pressure fuel-pump failure/stall recall; 20V-286 is the front lower suspension-arm separation/loss-of-control recall. Certain RAV4/RAV4 Hybrid year ranges appear in each filing, but only a VIN lookup establishes whether this specific vehicle has an unrepaired campaign. Remedies differ: fuel-pump replacement versus suspension-part replacement.

cases.question: A seller says a 2016 Toyota Prius needs the 20V-369 hybrid update. Check whether the campaign's model-year scope supports that claim, distinguish it from Prius V coverage, and explain how to verify this vehicle's own recalls.

criteria.fact: 20V-369 lists certain 2013–2015 Prius and 2014–2017 Prius V; the listed model-year range does not include a 2016 standard Prius.
Prius V is a distinct model name; its 2014–2017 years must not be transferred to a 2016 standard Prius.
Use the specific VIN to check the vehicle's open recalls and completion status; campaign-model-year mismatch does not clear other recalls.

ground_truth.expected_answer: The filing lists 2013–2015 Prius and 2014–2017 Prius V; it does not list a 2016 standard Prius. Do not transfer Prius V coverage. Check the actual VIN for this vehicle's own open recall status; the scope of one campaign does not rule out other recalls.

cases.question: The seller says a used 2019 RAV4 has an open recall, but gives no VIN or repair history. Ask what is needed before saying whether this exact vehicle needs a repair.

criteria.fact: Ask for the full 17-character VIN or direct the user to enter it in NHTSA/Toyota's lookup.
Do not assert that this individual vehicle has or lacks an unrepaired recall from model/year alone.
Explain that year/make/model searches show general campaigns, while VIN lookup is needed for vehicle-specific unrepaired status.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Ask for the 17-character VIN or have the owner use NHTSA/Toyota's VIN lookup. Model-year recall lists are general; they do not establish this vehicle's open/completed status.

cases.question: A family member says, 'My Prius has the hybrid-system recall.' They did not give the model year, Prius variant, VIN, or whether it was repaired. Ask first; don't assume the campaign applies.

criteria.fact: Ask for model year and whether it is Prius or Prius V, plus the VIN for vehicle-specific status.
Ask or explain that repair completion/open status requires VIN lookup or dealer confirmation.
Do not state that the recall applies or remains open based only on 'Prius'.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Ask the model year, Prius versus Prius V, and full VIN; confirm completion/open status through NHTSA/Toyota. Do not decide based on the family name alone.

cases.question: On the standard iPhone 15 (not Pro), what USB data rate is specified, and can its USB-C port output video to an external display?

criteria.fact: Standard iPhone 15 supports USB 2 data rates up to 480 Mb/s, not USB 3's 10 Gb/s rate.
Its USB-C connector supports DisplayPort video output.

ground_truth.expected_answer: The standard iPhone 15 supports USB 2 up to 480 Mb/s and DisplayPort video output over USB-C.

cases.question: For Google Pixel 8, report display size and weight, and explain exactly what Google's IP68 wording does and does not promise.

criteria.fact: Pixel 8 has a 6.2-inch display.
Pixel 8 weighs 187 g.
Google says it is designed to meet IP68 under IEC 60529 when it leaves the factory, but it is not waterproof; resistance can diminish and liquid damage voids warranty.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Pixel 8: 6.2-inch display and 187 g. Google describes IP68 as a factory-state rating, but explicitly says the device is not waterproof and resistance can diminish; liquid damage voids warranty.

cases.question: Compare data transfer over USB-C on standard iPhone 15 and iPhone 15 Pro. The seller says every iPhone 15 USB-C port is 10 Gb/s; check the exact variants and any cable caveat.

criteria.fact: Standard iPhone 15 is USB 2 up to 480 Mb/s.
iPhone 15 Pro supports USB 3 up to 10 Gb/s.
The Pro speed must not be attributed to the standard iPhone 15.
To reach USB 3 speeds, a USB 3-capable cable is required; the included charge cable is USB 2.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Standard iPhone 15 is USB 2 up to 480 Mb/s. iPhone 15 Pro supports USB 3 up to 10 Gb/s, and reaching that speed requires a USB 3 cable; the included cable is USB 2.

cases.question: A Pixel 8 owner says IP68 means it is safe for swimming and water damage is covered. Verify Google's rating caveats, how durability can change, and the warranty statement.

criteria.fact: The IP68 rating is a design rating under IEC 60529 when the device leaves the factory; it is not a guarantee that the phone is waterproof.
Water/dust resistance is not permanent and can diminish through wear, damage, repair or disassembly.
Google says liquid damage voids the warranty; do not promise swimming safety or warranty coverage.

ground_truth.expected_answer: IP68 is a factory-state design rating, not a claim that the Pixel 8 is waterproof or safe for swimming. Resistance can diminish through wear, damage, repair or disassembly; Google says liquid damage voids the warranty.

cases.question: A buyer's listing says iPhone 15, but they need to know whether it has a physical SIM tray. Ask what detail is needed before answering.

criteria.fact: Ask where the phone was purchased/its market or for the exact model number.
Apple's specs say a SIM tray is available on models purchased outside the U.S.; region matters.
Do not give a universal yes/no for all iPhone 15 units.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Ask for the country/market of purchase or exact model number. Apple says the SIM tray is present on iPhone 15 models purchased outside the U.S.; do not assume all markets match.

cases.question: A listing says Google Pixel 8, but the buyer wants a replacement battery and the seller doesn't know which version it is. Ask what is needed before recommending a part.

criteria.fact: Ask for the exact Pixel model/model number and region or the device identifiers visible in Settings/box before identifying a replacement part.
Do not infer part compatibility from the Pixel 8 family label alone.
Direct the buyer to Google-authorized repair/parts support after identification rather than inventing a battery part number.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Ask for the exact model number and market (or the device information from Settings/box), then confirm the part through Google-authorized repair support. Do not make up a battery part number from the family name.

cases.question: For Samsung refrigerators generally, how often does Samsung recommend changing the water filter, and what must I identify before buying a cartridge?

criteria.fact: Samsung recommends water-filter replacement every six months for optimal performance.
The compatible cartridge depends on the refrigerator model; identify the fridge model number or current cartridge before purchase.
Samsung's guide names HAF-CIN, HAF-QIN and HAFCU1 as filter types; they are not interchangeable by family name alone.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Samsung recommends changing the refrigerator water filter every six months. Filter fit depends on the fridge model; check its model code or the installed filter. The guide identifies HAF-CIN, HAF-QIN and HAFCU1 types.

cases.question: For Dyson V15 Detect, summarize how often Dyson says to wash the filter and the minimum drying instruction before putting it back.

criteria.fact: Dyson says to wash the V15 Detect filter once per month (more often may be needed in some use conditions).
After washing, dry for at least 24 hours with good airflow and ensure the filter is completely dry before reinsertion.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Dyson recommends washing the V15 Detect filter once a month, more often for some use. Let it dry for at least 24 hours with good airflow and reinstall only when fully dry.

cases.question: I have a Samsung refrigerator and want to replace its water filter. Give the correct identification steps, safe installation outline, flush/reset steps, and warn me where model differences matter.

criteria.fact: Find the refrigerator model number or read the existing cartridge; Samsung uses different filter models and replacement steps vary by fridge.
For the described filter replacement, turn off water supply before removing the filter.
Match the cartridge-specific lock/twist orientation; do not give one universal insertion method for every model.
After installation, dispense several gallons of water to clear impurities/air and reset the indicator using the fridge's model-specific controls.

ground_truth.expected_answer: First identify the fridge model or existing cartridge because Samsung uses several filter types and steps differ. Turn off water, remove/install using that cartridge's specified lock/twist direction, dispense several gallons after installation, then reset the filter light using the model's controls.

cases.question: My Dyson V15 Detect pulses, loses suction and runs out of battery quickly. Use Dyson's support steps to separate likely filter/power-mode checks from a confirmed battery failure; don't diagnose from symptoms alone.

criteria.fact: Dyson lists a dirty filter/blockage among possible causes of pulsing or poor performance and recommends regular filter washing.
The filter must be completely dry before reinstallation; the manual specifies at least 24 hours drying.
Boost/Max use reduces runtime and is intended for short intensive tasks; use an appropriate normal/auto mode for routine cleaning.
Battery runtime decline can have multiple causes and battery life is not a fixed number of years; contact Dyson/use genuine replacement support if checks point to the battery.
Do not claim the battery is definitively failed from these symptoms alone.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Check for blockages and clean the filter first; Dyson says a dirty filter can cause pulsing/poor performance. Dry it fully for at least 24 hours before reinstalling. Avoid continuous Boost/Max, which reduces runtime. Battery wear is variable and symptoms alone do not prove failure; follow Dyson's battery troubleshooting and genuine replacement/service route.

cases.question: I need a Samsung fridge water filter but I only know it is a French-door model. Ask what you need before recommending a cartridge.

criteria.fact: Ask for the full refrigerator model code from its label or the model number printed on the existing filter.
Do not choose a cartridge based only on the Samsung brand or French-door design.
Point to Samsung's model-based compatibility finder/manual after obtaining the identifier.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Ask for the refrigerator's full model code or the installed cartridge number/photo. Samsung models use different cartridges; use the model-based finder or manual once identified.

cases.question: A seller says this is a Dyson V15 but doesn't know whether it is Detect or V15s Submarine. The buyer needs a replacement filter and battery. Ask for the identifier needed before giving compatibility advice.

criteria.fact: Ask for the exact machine name/model code or serial number so Dyson can identify the machine and market.
Dyson support distinguishes V15 Detect SV22 and V15s Detect Submarine SV47 variants.
Do not assert battery/filter compatibility from the V15 family name alone.

ground_truth.expected_answer: Ask for the machine model code or serial number (and country if relevant); Dyson lists distinct V15 Detect SV22 and V15s Detect Submarine SV47 machines. Confirm parts in the matching support page before purchase.
